characters.name: Anthony Cade
characters.description: Adventurer and narrator; Englishman who travels under assumed names, becomes entangled in thefts, blackmail and murder, and ultimately assumes the identity/role of Prince Nicholas of Herzoslovakia; friend of Jimmy/James McGrath and suitor/husband of Virginia Revel.

characters.name: James (Jimmy) McGrath
characters.description: Canadian prospector and old friend of Anthony Cade; originally in possession of Count Stylptitch’s manuscript and letters; gold‑seeker and occasional troublemaker.

characters.name: Virginia Revel
characters.description: Widow (Hon. Mrs. Timothy Revel), charming, witty, and socially influential; former resident of Herzoslovakia and key figure in the plot—recognized Queen Varaga/Angèle Mory; later partner of Anthony Cade.

characters.name: Lord Caterham
characters.description: Clement Edward Alistair Brent, ninth Marquis of Caterham; owner of the country house Chimneys, hosts the house party and political meetings.

aliases.text: Clement Edward Alistair Brent, ninth Marquis of Caterham

characters.name: Hon. George Lomax
characters.description: Ambitious government official and political operator who organizes the Chimneys house party and is deeply involved in Herzoslovakian political manoeuvres.

characters.name: Bill Eversleigh
characters.description: Young, amiable Foreign Office subordinate to George Lomax; attends the party and attempts to help Virginia and others.

characters.name: Baron Lolopretjzyl
characters.description: Herzoslovakian nobleman and loyalist representative in London; concerned with restoration of the Herzoslovakian monarchy and the fate of the Stylptitch manuscript.

characters.name: Herman Isaacstein
characters.description: Financier representing syndicate interested in Herzoslovakian oil concessions; participant in negotiations at Chimneys.

characters.name: Superintendent Battle
characters.description: Scotland Yard superintendent assigned to investigate Prince Michael’s (Count Stanislaus’s) murder; methodical, imperturbable detective and later ally to Anthony.

characters.name: Inspector Badgworthy
characters.description: Local police inspector at Market Basing who first hears of the murder at Chimneys and assists early investigation.

characters.name: Constable Johnson
characters.description: New local police constable assisting at Chimneys; reports arrivals and local details.

characters.name: Dr. Cartwright
characters.description: Local doctor who examines the body and assists the police at Chimneys.

characters.name: Mademoiselle Brun
characters.description: French governess employed at Chimneys whose identity is later revealed to be false and central to the plot.

characters.name: Boris Anchoukoff
characters.description: Valet/servant to Prince Michael (Stanislaus); a devoted Herzoslovakian servant who plays a violent and vengeful role after his master’s death.

characters.name: Prince Michael of Herzoslovakia
characters.description: Incognito guest at Chimneys (staying as Count Stanislaus); pro‑British claimant to the Herzoslovakian throne who is murdered on the premises.

characters.name: King Victor
characters.description: Notorious international jewel thief and master of disguise (also referred to as Captain O’Neill); implicated in the wider intrigue concerning the missing jewel and operations against Stylptitch’s secrets.

characters.name: Angèle Mory / Queen Varaga
characters.description: Actress (Angèle Mory) who became Countess/Queen Varaga of Herzoslovakia in background history; central to the secret concerning the missing jewel; referenced in the narrative and linked to the letters.

characters.name: Count Stylptitch
characters.description: Late Count whose Memoirs (Reminiscences) are central to the plot; had knowledge of secrets including the jewel’s hiding place.

characters.name: Hiram P. Fish
characters.description: American visitor and collector of first editions who is revealed to be a Pinkerton operative involved in trailing King Victor.

characters.name: M. Lemoine
characters.description: Detective of the Sûreté (French police) who comes to assist; obsessed with capturing King Victor and at times at odds with the English detectives.

characters.name: Giuseppe Manelli
characters.description: Italian waiter (Giuseppe) who attempts to steal Anthony’s papers and is later found shot near Staines; involved in the blackmail subplot.

characters.name: Professor Wynward
characters.description: Cipher‑expert (professor) called in to decode Stylptitch’s letters; deciphers the crucial ‘Chimneys’ cipher.

characters.name: Mr. Balderson
characters.description: Publisher (of Balderson and Hodgkins) originally contracted for Stylptitch’s manuscript; sends a representative to collect it.

aliases.text: Mr. Balderson of Balderson and Hodgkins

characters.name: Mr. Holmes
characters.description: Representative/messenger sent by the publishers (Balderson & Hodgkins) who collects the manuscript from Anthony.

characters.name: Tredwell
characters.description: Long‑serving white‑haired butler at Chimneys, attentive to his master and the household’s needs.

characters.name: Chilvers
characters.description: Grave household functionary/footman at Pont Street for Virginia Revel; admits visitors and manages domestic errands.

characters.name: Élise
characters.description: Virginia Revel’s French maid who packs and manages household duties and who witnesses events at Pont Street.

characters.name: Lady Eileen "Bundle" Brent
characters.description: Lady Eileen Brent (nicknamed Bundle), Lord Caterham’s daughter—spirited, energetic, and practical; participates in investigating the house and its passages.

characters.name: Guggle
characters.description: Child of Lord Caterham (one of his daughters), known by the nickname Guggle; participates briefly in household scenes.

characters.name: Winkle
characters.description: Child of Lord Caterham (one of his daughters), known by the nickname Winkle; participates briefly in household scenes.

characters.name: Dutch Pedro
characters.description: Unnamed Herzoslovakian/foreigner (called Dutch Pedro) who bequeaths a packet of letters (blackmail material) to Jimmy McGrath before dying in Africa; his action sets the blackmail subplot in motion.

characters.name: Comrade of the Red Hand
characters.description: Unnamed member/representative of the revolutionary Comrades of the Red Hand who threatens and attempts to seize the manuscript; role repeated by several anonymous emissaries.

characters.name: Dorothy Kirkpatrick
characters.description: Actress/girl Bill Eversleigh took out (briefly mentioned); minor social figure in the narrative.
